CustomField.description: Predefined recipient categories for this email alert. Used only when ActionKind__c = EmailAlert. CurrentStepApprovers: approvers assigned to the step being actioned. NextStepApprovers: approvers of the step being advanced to (resolved dynamically). Submitter: the user who submitted the record for approval. RecordOwner: the Owner field on the target record.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Select one or more categories. These are resolved at runtime from the approval context. Use AdditionalQueues__c and AdditionalUsers__c to add specific recipients beyond these categories.
CustomField.label: Recipient Type
